headline: Lykos Line Shifts as Main Fronts Cool
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Lykos Isle has moved to a four-base Warden, three-base Colonial balance, with two ownership events in the latest two hours and fighting still brisk on both casualty ledgers. Fisherman’s Row, formerly the busiest fresh front, has recorded no new movement in that window; its contested board remains six Colonial bases to three Warden, though 20 events mark it as the day’s most active ledger. Linn Mercy retains all 11 bases under Warden control but leads the field with 32 events over 24 hours, while the latest two-hour lull contrasts with heavy earlier losses. Stonecradle has likewise gone quiet recently after 12 daily events and remains entirely Warden-held. Deadlands continues as a divided and exceptionally costly sector—four Warden bases against seven Colonial—with seven ownership events and renewed enlistment activity. Stlican Shelf, eight Warden to one Colonial, saw six daily events but none in the latest six hours. The great casualty mills of Weathered Expanse, Clahstra, and Loch Mor remain active in manpower terms, yet show no fresh base movement in the latest two-hour report.
